## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      16 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 20 avr. 2026 - 13 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Tech44_, 13 oct. 2026, 1/5: "Well, notion is a great service to organize just about any type of information, but the iOS app is terrible. Incredibly buggy, that seems to get worse with every update. I’m still using it because I have too much invested in the platform, so I hope they get around to fixing everything."
            2. _User1opj_, 9 oct. 2026, 1/5: "If I had not used it in writing notes in Mac already, I would never used it in my iPad cause the app here is disappointing for the following reasons This app is difficult to use as a note taken in IOS : - Always lagging - when I try to type using iPad keyboard I can’t see what I am writing cause the page will scroll down every single time - not apple pencil friendly, text difficult to recognize (when I try to select words[writing and editing using it is something I had long since learned that they will never fix it{) - AI support is not optimum in iPad, whenever I will use it the app will lag and I need to close it and reopen to continue my notes taken - can not search in the page alone - I can not change the color of any text , it will immediately lag , and do not apply the color changes - difficult to move text Keep in mind I am using a new empty page !!!"
            3. _AndrewLuisBox_, 7 oct. 2026, 1/5: "Too slow and waste my time and always asked money ."
